battle_result_processed_occurred.meaning: a single battle result was processed by battleElo and Elo.ratingChange was called to obtain change

negative_flag.meaning: the negative flag returned by Elo.ratingChange indicating eloB's rating should decrease (true) or increase (false)

elo_b_direction_correct.meaning: eloB's rating is adjusted in the direction indicated by negative (decrease when true, increase when false)

elo_a_direction_correct.meaning: eloA's rating is adjusted in the direction indicated by negative (increase when true, decrease when false)

dependent_data_correct.meaning: protocol functionality relying on the calculated Elo ratings operates on correct rating data

assumptions: battleElo is invoked to process a battle result and applies the returned change to eloA and eloB.
The negative flag is the value returned by Elo.ratingChange for the processed battle result.
Downstream protocol functionality consumes the updated Elo ratings.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who invokes battleElo or any authorization condition; the caller/authorization scope of the rating update is unspecified.
Report gives no concrete numeric elo values or change amounts, so the magnitude of the direction inversion cannot be quantified.

limitations: Direction correctness is encoded as grounded Boolean observables because the report states the direction relation qualitatively without numeric elo values or change amounts.

The dependent_functions_wrong_data impact is potential and conditional on other protocol functionality relying on the Elo ratings; the plan encodes only the correctness of the data those functions would consume.
The negative_true_case and negative_false_case preconditions are mutually exclusive branches of the same flag; they are listed as separate P terms per source but cannot hold simultaneously.
